articles.title: 50,000 N Korean Troops Could Enter War? Zelensky's Big Warning | Watch
articles.description: Ukraine is warning of a major expansion in North Korea’s military support for Russia, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy claiming Pyongyang could send up to 50,000 troops to fight alongside Russian forces. Kyiv says North Korean military personnel and equipment are already moving into western Russia, while a North Korean missile unit is reportedly deploying there. Zelenskyy has also urged South Korea to strengthen Ukraine’s air-defence capabilities, warning that Pyongyang is gaining valuable battlefield experience and receiving military technology from Moscow. Ukraine says North Korea has already supplied Russia with artillery shells, missiles and other weapons.
